intro: The ten most-played Roblox games right now. Pumpkins everywhere.
method: Ranked by live player counts on the public tracker rblxstat.com (Oct 21, 2026). Counts swing a lot over a day, so close neighbors can swap places hour to hour. This is our first chart; week-over-week movement starts next week.

entries.name: Steal An Egg
entries.note: Still number one by a wide margin, now with a Halloween Dimension.

entries.name: Murder Mystery 2
entries.note: The 2014 classic is pulling more than 650,000 players at once.

entries.name: Brookhaven RP
entries.note: Its Halloween trick-or-treating update lands Oct 23.

entries.name: Adopt Me!
entries.note: Week 4 of its Halloween update starts Oct 23.

entries.name: Steal a Brainrot
entries.note: Far below its 2025 peaks, but still top five.

entries.name: Jujutsu Shenanigans
entries.note: Its delayed Halloween update is set for Oct 23.

entries.name: 99 Nights in the Forest
entries.note: One of nine games in Roblox's The Hollow event.

entries.name: Blox Fruits
entries.note: Steady as ever, no Halloween event listed yet.

entries.name: Dress To Impress
entries.note: Its big Halloween and fall update runs until Nov 7.
